svg.title: Background. Experience, oldest first: AI Algorithm Intern at Beidou Institute, Shenzhen, video anomaly event detection for China Resources property management; Intern at Hua Xia Bank (branch), credit due-diligence assistant agent and client requirements; ongoing research at the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, and at Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, CAS. Education: The University of Hong Kong, MSc, 2026 onwards; The University of Sydney, Finance and Computer Science, Dalyell Scholar; Zhejiang University, short-term exchange. Research: spatial intelligence; multimodal long-video understanding and grounding; embodied AI (future); enterprise AI agents.
